rationale: With only 5 minutes to close, the last candle shows a sharp drop from ~$34.87 to $34.70 on elevated volume (89,600 shares), suggesting selling pressure, but price is below VWAP ($34.84) and the 9-EMA ($34.92), making a long risky. The reward/risk profile in either direction does not justify entry this close to the bell.
